title: Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band live: Radio City Music Hall, New York City | 2006
content:
Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band performed at the Radio City Music Hall in New York City, USA, on 20 July 2006.

It was the final show by the ninth All-Starr Band. Their tour of North America lasted for 25 dates in June and July 2006.

Starr previously performed at the Radio City Music Hall on 19 and 20 June 1992, 13 July 1995, and 29 July 2003. He returned there on 24 June 2008, 7 July 2010, 13 September 2018, 25 September 2024, and 13 June 2025.

The ninth All-Starr Band

  • Ringo Starr: vocals, drums, percussion
  • Billy Squier: vocals, guitar
  • Richard Marx: vocals, guitar, keyboards
  • Edgar Winter: vocals, keyboards, saxophone
  • Rod Argent: vocals, organ, keyboards
  • Hamish Stuart: vocals, bass guitar
  • Sheila E: vocals, drums, percussion
